title: polyDegreeLt is subadditive under polyMul (the Cauchy-product convolution)
statement: If polyDegreeLt c m and polyDegreeLt g n then polyDegreeLt (polyMul c g) (m+n) -- multiplying two coefficient functions (via the antidiagonal Cauchy-product convolution polyMul) adds their degree bounds.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.polyDegreeLt_polyMul : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : Complex.polyDegreeLt x0 x2) -> ((x5 : Complex.polyDegreeLt x1 x3) -> Complex.polyDegreeLt (Complex.polyMul x0 x1) (AxNat.add x2 x3)))))))
